audience: Shopify and ecommerce merchants who run a loyalty and rewards program with Smile.io

useCases.title: Look up a loyalty customer and their points history
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by exact email, reads the points balance and VIP tier, and lists every earn, spend and manual adjustment, newest first.

useCases.title: Review rewards and the ways customers earn points
useCases.text: The AI lists the points products customers can redeem and the enabled earning rules, such as orders, sign-ups and birthdays. You see what the program offers.

useCases.title: Check issued rewards and whether they were used
useCases.text: The AI lists reward fulfillments, usually discount codes, with fulfillment status and usage status. You can see which codes were used or are still unused.

useCases.title: Review VIP tiers and the referral program
useCases.text: The AI lists the VIP tiers by milestone with their perks and entry rewards, and reads the referral settings with the sender and receiver rewards.

useCases.title: Adjust points, record activities or redeem rewards
useCases.text: The AI adjusts a customer's points balance up or down with a note, or records an activity so Smile applies the earning rules. It can also redeem points for a reward when the customer asked.
